run_bbox_augmented_detection: run bounding box detection with test-time augmentation including flips and multiple scales on images
run_bbox_detection: run bounding box detection on original images with resize, tensor conversion, and normalization transforms
run_bbox_hflip_detection: run bounding box detection on horizontally flipped images and transpose detections back to original orientation
run_bbox_scale_detection: run bounding box detection at a specified scale with optional horizontal flip for multi-scale inference
review_bbox_aug_functions: review the im_detect_bbox_aug function that merges detections from multiple transforms and applies NMS
